The Chandelier, X:4

This was on my list of tunes to learn from Liz Carrol’s version. I found it a bit different than the one I found here so I decided to post. This will take me a lot of work and imaginative ornamentation to make it work on my flute but I think it’s doable. I think I may have some confusion in the melody/double stops. I’ll edit it later if needed when I get a little further along.
